mapper.select: WHERE (v.vehicle_qr_code = #{qrCode} OR v.vehicle_qr_token = #{qrCode}) GROUP BY v.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_vehicle SET status=2, current_warehouse_id=#{warehouseId}, current_location_id=#{locationId}, stock_in_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{vehicleId} AND status=1

UPDATE bike_vehicle v JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=#{orderId} AND o.customer_id=#{customerId} JOIN bike_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id AND i.product_model_id=v.model_id SET v.status=3, v.stock_out_time=NOW(3), v.current_customer_id=#{customerId}, v.current_order_no=o.order_no WHERE v.id=#{vehicleId} AND v.status=2
UPDATE bike_vehicle SET status=1, current_warehouse_id=NULL, current_location_id=NULL, stock_in_time=NULL WHERE id=#{vehicleId} AND status=2
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_warehouse_location l JOIN bike_warehouse w ON w.id=l.warehouse_id WHERE l.id=#{locationId} AND l.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND l.status='ENABLED' AND w.status='ENABLED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_inventory_lock WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND product_model_id=#{modelId} AND status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED') AND expire_time > NOW() AND lock_qty > released_qty + converted_qty
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_sales_order o JOIN bike_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id SET o.status=CASE WHEN i.shipped_qty=0 THEN 'CONFIRMED' WHEN i.shipped_qty < i.ordered_qty THEN 'PARTIAL_SHIPPED' ELSE 'SHIPPED' END WHERE o.id=#{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_sales_order_vehicle(order_id,vehicle_id,stock_out_record_id) SELECT #{orderId},#{vehicleId},id FROM bike_stock_out_record WHERE stock_out_no=#{stockNo}
mapper.sql: SELECT si.id,si.stock_in_no stock_no,'IN' type,si.vehicle_id,v.frame_sn,si.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name,si.location_id,l.location_name,si.status,si.operation_time,si.cancel_reason FROM bike_stock_in_record si JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.id=si.vehicle_id JOIN bike_warehouse w ON w.id=si.warehouse_id JOIN bike_warehouse_location l ON l.id=si.location_id

SELECT so.id,so.stock_out_no stock_no,'OUT' type,so.vehicle_id,v.frame_sn,so.customer_id,c.customer_name,so.order_id,o.order_no,so.status,so.operation_time,so.cancel_reason FROM bike_stock_out_record so JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.id=so.vehicle_id JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id=so.customer_id JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=so.order_id
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_stock_in_record SET status='CANCELLED',cancel_reason=#{reason},cancelled_by=#{operatorId},cancelled_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='COMPLETED'
UPDATE bike_stock_out_record SET status='CANCELLED',cancel_reason=#{reason},cancelled_by=#{operatorId},cancelled_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='COMPLETED'
mapper.select: WITH inventory_rows AS ( SELECT m.id model_id,m.model_name,w.id warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name,l.id location_id,l.location_name, COUNT(v.id) physical_qty,COALESCE(il.locked_qty,0) model_locked_qty, COALESCE(DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(),MIN(v.stock_in_time)),0) age_days, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.id ORDER BY COALESCE(w.id,0),COALESCE(l.id,0)) row_no FROM bike_vehicle v LEFT JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=v.model_id LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse w ON w.id=v.current_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse_location l ON l.id=v.current_location_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_model_id,SUM(lock_qty-released_qty-converted_qty) locked_qty FROM bike_inventory_lock WHERE status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED') AND expire_time>NOW() AND lock_qty > released_qty + converted_qty AND agent_id=#{agentId} GROUP BY product_model_id) il ON il.product_model_id=v.model_id WHERE v.status=2 AND v.model_id=#{modelId}AND v.current_warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} GROUP BY m.id,m.model_name,w.id,w.warehouse_name,l.id,l.location_name,il.locked_qty ), allocated_rows AS ( SELECT inventory_rows.*, GREATEST(LEAST(model_locked_qty - COALESCE(SUM(physical_qty) OVER ( PARTITION BY model_id ORDER BY row_no ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0), physical_qty), 0) locked_qty FROM inventory_rows ) SELECT model_id,model_name,warehouse_id,warehouse_name,location_id,location_name,physical_qty,locked_qty, physical_qty-locked_qty available_qty,age_days FROM allocated_rows ORDER BY physical_qty DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_vehicle WHERE status=2
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(lock_qty-released_qty-converted_qty),0) FROM bike_inventory_lock WHERE status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED') AND expire_time>NOW() AND lock_qty > released_qty + converted_qty
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_operation_log(business_type,business_id,action,frame_sn,operator_id,operator_name,before_data,after_data,client_ip,remark) VALUES(#{businessType},#{businessId},#{action},#{frameSn},#{operatorId},#{operatorName},JSON_OBJECT('status', CASE WHEN #{businessType}='STOCK_IN' THEN '组装完成' WHEN #{businessType}='STOCK_OUT' THEN '已入库' WHEN #{businessType}='STOCK_IN_CANCEL' THEN '已入库' WHEN #{businessType}='STOCK_OUT_CANCEL' THEN '已出库' ELSE '未知' END),JSON_OBJECT('status', CASE WHEN #{businessType}='STOCK_IN' THEN '已入库' WHEN #{businessType}='STOCK_OUT' THEN '已出库' WHEN #{businessType}='STOCK_IN_CANCEL' THEN '组装完成' WHEN #{businessType}='STOCK_OUT_CANCEL' THEN '已入库' ELSE '未知' END),#{clientIp},#{remark})
